info.title: Rumi Billing Service API
info.description: REST API of the Billing bounded context: subscription plans (US05), subscription status with the payment history (US07) and online payment through a simulated payment gateway (US24). Every route is for administrators and is called through the API gateway, which sets the X-User-Id and X-Role headers.

post.summary: Choose a plan for a building
post.description: US05. Creates the subscription of the building as PENDING_PAYMENT; an approved payment (POST /api/v1/payments) activates it. A building can have only one subscription that is pending payment or active; an active one past its expiry is closed as EXPIRED and the building may choose again. The building is not checked against the Building service yet. Call it through the API gateway with 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' of an administrator; the gateway sets X-User-Id and X-Role.

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Id of the signed-in administrator, set by the API gateway from the token; clients do not send it

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: Role of the signed-in user, set by the API gateway from the token; it must be ADMINISTRATOR

201.description: The subscription was created; Location points to it

400.description: Invalid data; field errors are listed in 'errors'

409.description: The building already has a subscription pending payment or active

value.title: Conflict
value.detail: The building already has a subscription that is pending payment or active.

401.description: The request did not come through the gateway with a valid token

value.title: Unauthorized
value.detail: The request has no valid X-User-Id header. Call this endpoint through the API gateway with a valid token.

403.description: The signed-in user is not an administrator

value.title: Forbidden
value.detail: Only an administrator can manage subscriptions and payments.

post.description: US24. Charges the price of the plan to the card through the payment gateway (simulated today: 4000000000000002 is declined, any other valid card is approved). An approved payment activates a subscription pending payment, renews an active one from its current expiry, or restarts an expired one from now. A declined payment is kept as REJECTED and answered with 402. Only the brand and the last four digits of the card are kept. Sending the same Idempotency-Key again answers with the payment already made (200) and charges nothing. Call it through the API gateway with 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' of an administrator; the gateway sets X-User-Id and X-Role.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key, at most 64 characters, that makes retries safe: the same key never charges twice

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Id of the signed-in administrator, set by the API gateway from the token; clients do not send it

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: Role of the signed-in user, set by the API gateway from the token; it must be ADMINISTRATOR

200.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used for this subscription; nothing was charged and the stored payment is returned

400.description: Invalid data: missing fields, a number that fails the Luhn check, an expired card or a CVV of the wrong length. The card data is never echoed

401.description: The request did not come through the gateway with a valid token

value.title: Unauthorized
value.detail: The request has no valid X-User-Id header. Call this endpoint through the API gateway with a valid token.

402.description: The gateway declined the payment; the attempt is kept as REJECTED

403.description: The signed-in user is not an administrator

value.title: Forbidden
value.detail: Only an administrator can manage subscriptions and payments.

404.description: The subscription does not exist or belongs to another administrator

409.description: The subscription is cancelled or replaced, or the Idempotency-Key was used for another subscription

value.title: Conflict
value.detail: The Idempotency-Key was already used for another subscription.

get.summary: Check that the service is running
get.description: Skeleton endpoint used to verify deployment and gateway routing. It is not a functional endpoint of the bounded context.

ChooseSubscriptionRequest.description: The plan chosen for a building

buildingId.description: Id of the building in the Building service

code.description: Code used to choose the plan

billingCycle.description: How often the plan is paid

sensorLimit.description: Maximum number of sensors of the building

status.description: Status as of now: an active subscription past its expiry is EXPIRED

startsAt.description: When the current period started; null until the first approved payment

expiresAt.description: When the subscription expires; null until the first approved payment

CardRequest.description: The card to charge. It is never stored, logged or returned

number.description: Card number; it must pass the Luhn check. Test cards: 4111111111111111 is approved, 4000000000000002 is declined

cvv.description: Security code: 3 digits, or 4 for AMEX

subscriptionId.description: Id of the subscription to pay

PaymentResponse.description: A payment attempt. Only the brand and last four digits of the card are kept

cardLast4.description: Last four digits of the card
